final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor introduced no new admissible evidence and instead narrowed the claim to a caveated operational-readiness position. That clarification is useful but it does not satisfy the enterprise policy predicates already identified in the initial audit. The admissible record still shows: the student aid advising segment remains below target and exposed in the initial rollout cohort; the available risk acceptance is only a draft with a blank approver line and no mention of that exposure; and policy requires disclosure of the material limitation unless it is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. Aggregate readiness, rehearsal success, staged rollout, rollback, and monitoring remain relevant to operational control, but they are insufficient while the exposed use case remains live and disclosure completion is unproven. This is therefore not compliant or compliant_with_caveats on the present record; it remains a plausible certification narrative with an unresolved required compliance predicate.
